text:
@gotrock4 covered calls are where you sell calls for stocks you own.

Their value comes on stocks where selling the stock would cause you to be exposed to capital gains tax and you expect the stock price to not meaningfully change either way for a period of time.

In that circumstance it means you can gain money by collecting the call premium for the assets you own. It's a low risk way to gain some extra income in that situation. Rather than taking the tax on the chin and moving it to somewhere where you expect some growth.

Puts are indeed simply hedging though. Though in an environment where you may believe we have a bubble or don't like the geopolitical uncertainty, with a large portfolio due to the comparative low cost may have decent value.
